_comment: Internal presets: each emotion picks a preset, i.e. a Gradium voice (FR or EN, chosen from the language of the text). Voice ids are Gradium flagship voices (docs.gradium.ai/guides/voices/flagship-voices). The emotion's excitement level then sets temperature and speed through 'delivery'.

presets._voices: Coralie (giggly) / Marlowe (a laugh under every word)

delivery._comment: Excitement level 0..1 -> Gradium json_config, linearly. temp = sampling variability (Gradium: 0.3 for repeatable renders, 0.9-1.1 for character or expressive work; range 0-1.4). padding_bonus = speed (negative = faster; 2.0 is already clearly slower). Level 0.5 gives Gradium's defaults (temp 0.7, padding 0). The length adjustment for long texts is added on top.
